headline: MKDW repurchased approximately $7 million worth of its outstanding ordinary shares.
summary: MKDWELL Tech Inc. (NASDAQ: MKDW), an automotive electronics manufacturer, announced a stock repurchase agreement to buy back 34.58 million ordinary shares at $0.203 per share for approximately $7 million. The company's CEO stated the repurchase aims to protect shareholder value amid undervalued share prices, while acknowledging challenges from macroeconomic volatility and new US tariffs.
